$comment: Dyno's CI contract (scripts/affected.mjs, .gitea/actions/app-gates, ADR 0014 §6; the field list is in .gitea/actions/README.md): a leg of ci.yml on Linux (the capabilities and CSP check; fmt, clippy, nextest incl. the Linux adapters against the container's real /proc, doc tests, deny; then the frontend: audit, lint, build, index.html check, unit tests with coverage and once more in another time zone; the Chromium e2e in two parallel legs, `e2e`/`e2eShards`, and the WebKit e2e in a leg of its own, `e2eWebkit`, on main, tags, the nightly and a dispatch with `webkit`) and, for the OS adapters (launch agent, Unix sockets, SIGSTOP/SIGCONT duty cycles, lsof, codesign; the Windows adapters), the Rust gates on Windows and macOS, clippy on Windows too (`windowsClippy`: the Windows adapters are linted where they compile). Commands run from the repo root, one per line of a step; one `cd` holds for the lines after it. Installers, the run-path and seal checks of the packaged binaries, the agent's one real measurement from the built macOS app (apps/dyno/scripts/check-bundle.sh) and the release are .gitea/workflows/dyno-release.yml (a dyno-v* tag, a push to main, the nightly or a manual run), through the shared app-release.yml.
